content_rules: This file never contains prices, currency amounts, trial durations, discount figures, credit quantities or Premium feature lists. Answers always point to the in-app Premium or Wallet screen or to the store purchase sheet.
This file and the support chat never contain Scripture text, Scripture interpretation, prayer text or personal guidance. Those requests are redirected.
Placeholders may only come from the variables block. An unresolved placeholder must never be shown to the user; use variables.fallbacks instead.
FAQ ids are permanent. Never rename or reuse an id. Locale files, analytics and support history depend on them.
If an action target does not exist in the app, hide that action. Never show a dead button.
Locale files are named support_content.<locale>.json, keep identical ids, and fall back to fallback_language for any missing key.

Visibility: an item (category, subcategory, FAQ, issue type, action, suggested prompt) is shown only if ALL of its requires_feature flags are on, AND at least one of its requires_any_feature flags is on (when present), AND none of its excludes_feature flags is on. A category or subcategory with no visible FAQ is hidden. Hidden FAQs are not matched locally and are not indexed for the support AI.
Routes: action_registry.route_requirements lists the feature flags each action target needs. An action whose target requirement is not met is hidden automatically, even if the FAQ itself is visible.

Conditional text: answer.append_if_feature holds extra text that is appended to the answer (as an extra paragraph, or as an extra final step when the answer uses steps) only when its feature flag is on. Use it instead of mentioning optional features in the base text.
Base text of an FAQ may only mention features that the FAQ's own visibility rules guarantee. Mention anything else through append_if_feature.
Related articles: related_faq_ids lists FAQ ids for the Related Articles block on the answer screen. Show only visible FAQs, up to faq_detail.related_limit.

Credit and quota values (cost of a feature, size of a free allowance, timer intervals, ad rewards) are never written in this file. The app shows the real values on its own screens before the user spends or earns anything.
Restore Purchases applies to Premium purchases only. Consumable credit packs are not restored, so credit problems use the credits_missing flow instead.

AI answer pricing by length: apps with ai_length_credits charge credits for every AI answer, from the first one, based on the length the user picks (short, medium or long). The file describes this without amounts. The app shows the credit cost for each length before the user confirms.

Daily content: apps with offline_daily_content provide the daily verse, prayer and devotion for the user's connection level, and the daily streak, without internet. They are free: no credits, no AI and no Premium.

Prayer Wall: posts are shared with other users. Help text tells users not to post private details. Reports use the report_problem flow, and support chat never writes, answers or comments on prayer requests.
resolution_order: Filter by feature flags and platform
Resolve platform_overrides for the current platform

supplied_by_app.STORE_NAME: App Store or Google Play, chosen by platform

supplied_by_server.RESPONSE_TIME: Optional. Human-readable expected reply time, maintained server-side
supplied_by_server.CRISIS_RESOURCES: Regional crisis-line text, maintained and verified server-side

fallbacks.CRISIS_RESOURCES: Please contact your local emergency services.

faq.question: How do I create a Verse Challenge?
faq.preview: Make a quiz from Scripture and share it.

answer.title: Create a Verse Challenge
steps: Open the Verse Challenge section.
Choose to create a new challenge.
Follow the steps to choose your verses and quiz type.
Create it, then share the link with the people you want to invite.

faq.question: How many challenges can I create for free each day?
faq.preview: Understand your free daily creation.

answer.title: Free Daily Creation
answer.body: Creating a quiz includes a free daily allowance. The create screen shows what you have available today, and what your options are once the free creation has been used.

faq.question: How do I share my challenge?
faq.preview: Send your challenge to anyone, anywhere.

answer.title: Share Your Challenge
answer.body: After you create a challenge, choose Share and pick any messaging or social app on your device. There is no restriction on where or how many times you share it.

faq.question: How do I invite friends or family to play?
faq.preview: Let others take your challenge.

answer.title: Invite Others
answer.body: Share your challenge link in any messaging or social app. Anyone who opens the link can play right away. They don't need to install {{APP_NAME}} or create an account.

faq.question: Can the people I invite share the challenge too?
faq.preview: Passing a challenge along.

answer.title: Sharing by Players
answer.body: Yes. Anyone who plays a challenge can share its link with others, with no restriction.

faq.question: How do I play a challenge someone sent me?
faq.preview: Open the link and start playing.

answer.title: Play a Challenge
steps: Open the link you received.
The challenge opens and you can start answering right away.
You don't need to install {{APP_NAME}} or create an account.
Playing is free, and you can play again as often as you like.

faq.question: Is there a limit on players, plays or how long a link works?
faq.preview: Players, plays and link validity.

answer.title: No Limits on Playing
answer.body: No. Any number of people can play, they can play as many times as they like, and a shared challenge link does not expire.

faq.question: What are the 50/50, hint and skip options in a quiz?
faq.preview: Use credits for extra help while you play.

answer.title: Quiz Helpers
answer.body: While playing a quiz you can use helpers such as 50/50, a hint, or skipping a question. Each one uses credits, and the cost is shown before you confirm. If you don't have enough credits, you can get more from the Wallet.

faq.question: Where can I see how many people played my challenge?
faq.preview: Track plays and results.

answer.title: Challenge Results
answer.body: Open your challenge from your list and view its results. You can see how many people have played and the percentage figures for your challenge.

faq.question: How do I edit my challenge?
faq.preview: Change your questions or verses.

answer.title: Edit a Challenge
steps: Open your challenge from your list and choose Edit.
Make your changes and save them.
Share the challenge again so people see the updated content. The link stays the same.

faq.question: I edited my challenge, but people still see the old version.
faq.preview: Update what people see.

answer.title: Old Version Still Showing
answer.body: Changes you make in the app only update what people see once you share the challenge again. Open the challenge and share it again. The link stays the same and will show the updated content.

faq.question: How do I delete a challenge?
faq.preview: Remove a challenge from your list.

answer.title: Delete a Challenge
answer.body: Open your challenge and choose Delete. This removes it from your list in the app. A link you already shared can keep working, because shared challenges are served from our servers. If you need help with a link you already shared, contact App Support.

faq.question: How do I get started with {{APP_NAME}}?
faq.preview: A quick tour of the basics.

answer.title: Getting Started
answer.body: Choose what to read from the book and chapter selector, then scroll to move through the chapter. Select a verse to see actions such as bookmark, highlight, note, copy and share. Reading options are in the appearance settings.

faq.question: How do I go to a specific book, chapter or verse?
faq.preview: Jump straight to the passage you want.

answer.title: Go to a Passage
steps: Open the book and chapter selector.
Choose a book, then a chapter.
Or open Search and type a reference, such as a book name followed by a chapter and verse number.

faq.question: How do I continue where I left off?
faq.preview: Return to your last reading position.

answer.title: Continue Reading
answer.body: {{APP_NAME}} remembers your last reading position and opens there when you return. If it opens somewhere else, use the book and chapter selector or your bookmarks to go back.

faq.question: How do I change the Bible text size or font?
faq.preview: Make Scripture comfortable to read.

answer.title: Adjust Text Size
steps: Open the reading or appearance settings.
Adjust the text size until it is comfortable.

faq.question: How do I change the reading theme or use dark mode?
faq.preview: Choose a comfortable look for reading.

answer.title: Change Reading Theme
answer.body: Open the appearance settings and choose from the themes available in {{APP_NAME}}. If your app has a night or dark option, you will find it there too.

faq.question: How do I copy a verse?
faq.preview: Copy Scripture to paste elsewhere.

answer.title: Copy a Verse
answer.body: Select the verse you want and choose Copy from the verse actions. You can then paste it into any other app.

faq.question: How do I read two versions side by side?
faq.preview: Compare Bible versions while you read.

answer.title: Read Versions Together
answer.body: Open the reading options and choose the option to show a second version. Pick the version you want to compare, and turn it off the same way when you are done.

faq.question: How do I adjust the screen brightness in the app?
faq.preview: Control brightness for comfortable reading.

answer.title: Adjust Brightness
answer.body: Open the reading settings and use the brightness control. Your device brightness settings also affect how bright the screen is.

faq.question: Can I show or hide verse numbers?
faq.preview: Choose how Scripture looks while you read.

answer.title: Show or Hide Verse Numbers
answer.body: Open the reading settings and use the verse number option to show or hide verse numbers.

faq.question: How do I change the reading view, such as single column?
faq.preview: Choose a reading layout.

answer.title: Reading View Options
answer.body: Open the reading settings and choose a reading view from the options offered.

faq.question: How do I stop the screen from sleeping while I read?
faq.preview: Keep the display on while reading.

answer.title: Keep the Screen Awake
answer.body: Turn on the keep-screen-awake option in the reading settings. Your device's own auto-lock settings can also affect when the screen turns off.

faq.question: How do I change the font?
faq.preview: Choose a reading font.

answer.title: Change the Font
answer.body: Open the reading or appearance settings and choose a font from the ones offered.

faq.question: How do I change the Bible version?
faq.preview: Switch to another available translation.

answer.title: Change Bible Version
steps: Open the Bible version selector from the reading screen.
Select the version you want to read.

append_if_feature.text: If the version needs to be downloaded first, wait for the download to finish before opening it.

faq.question: How do I download a Bible version?
faq.preview: Download a version to read it anytime.

answer.title: Download a Bible Version
steps: Open the Bible version selector.
Find the version you want and tap Download.
Keep the app open until the download completes.

faq.question: Why can't I find a Bible version, book or language?
faq.preview: What to check if something is missing.

answer.title: Can't Find a Version or Book
answer.body: {{APP_NAME}} includes only the content shown in its own version list and book list. If something you expect is missing, check that you are looking at the right version. You can also ask us to add it.

append_if_feature.text: If you were downloading it, wait for the download to finish.

faq.question: Can you add another Bible translation or language?
faq.preview: Tell us which content you would like.

answer.title: Request New Content
answer.body: We'd like to hear what you need. Send a content request with the translation or language you want, and our team will review it. We can't promise every request, but each one is read.

faq.question: How do I listen to the Bible audio?
faq.preview: Play audio for the chapter you are reading.

answer.title: Listen to Audio
steps: Open the chapter you want to hear.
Tap the audio or play button.
Use the player controls to pause, skip or go back.

faq.question: How do I download audio?
faq.preview: Save audio to listen without internet.

answer.title: Download Audio
steps: Open the audio player or the downloads screen.
Choose the book or chapter you want to save.
Tap Download and keep the app open until it finishes.

faq.question: Can I change the audio speed or set a sleep timer?
faq.preview: Control how and how long audio plays.

answer.title: Audio Speed and Sleep Timer
answer.body: Open the audio player and look for the speed and timer controls. A sleep timer stops the audio after the time you choose.

faq.question: Will audio keep playing when my screen is locked?
faq.preview: Listen while using other apps or with the screen off.

answer.title: Audio in the Background
answer.body: Audio can keep playing when you lock your screen or switch to another app. If it stops, check that low-power or battery-saving modes are not restricting {{APP_NAME}} in your device settings.

faq.question: Why is audio not available for my Bible version?
faq.preview: Audio is not offered for every version.

answer.title: Audio Availability
answer.body: Audio is not available for every version or language. If the audio button is missing for the version you are reading, audio is not offered for it in {{APP_NAME}} right now. You can send us a content request.

faq.question: How do I add or remove a bookmark?
faq.preview: Save a verse to find it later.

answer.title: Bookmark a Verse
steps: Select the verse you want to save.
Choose the bookmark option from the verse actions.
To remove it, select the bookmarked verse and choose the bookmark option again, or remove it from your bookmarks list.

faq.question: Where are my bookmarks and notes?
faq.preview: Find verses and notes you have saved.

answer.title: Find Your Bookmarks and Notes
answer.body: Open the saved content section to see your bookmarks, notes and highlights. Select an item to return to its passage.

faq.question: How do I add or edit a note?
faq.preview: Write your own thoughts beside a verse.

answer.title: Add or Edit a Note
steps: Select the verse you want to write about.
Choose the note option from the verse actions.
Type your note and save it. To change it later, open it from your notes list.

faq.question: How do I highlight a verse?
faq.preview: Mark important verses while you read.

answer.title: Highlight a Verse
answer.body: Select the verse and choose the highlight option from the verse actions. Pick a colour or style if your app offers them.

faq.question: How do I remove a highlight?
faq.preview: Clear highlighting from a verse.

answer.title: Remove a Highlight
answer.body: Select the highlighted verse, open its highlight options, and choose the option to remove or clear the highlight.

faq.question: How do I search for a verse or passage?
faq.preview: Find Scripture by word, phrase or reference.

answer.title: Search the Bible
answer.body: Open Search and enter a word, a phrase, or a reference made of a book, chapter and verse. Select a result to open that passage.

faq.question: Why is Search not finding what I typed?
faq.preview: Tips to get better results.

answer.title: Search Not Finding Results
steps: Check your spelling and try fewer or simpler words.
Make sure the Bible version you are searching is the one you expect, because wording differs between versions.

append_if_feature.text: If a version is still downloading, wait for it to finish and search again.

faq.question: Can I use the app without internet?
faq.preview: What works while you're offline.

answer.title: Using the App Offline
answer.body: Content already stored on your device can be used without an internet connection. Features that need online services, such as the support assistant, need an active connection.

append_if_feature.text: Your daily verse, prayer and devotion, and your daily streak, also work without internet.
AI features, including the Bible Assistant, need an internet connection.

faq.question: The app is using too much storage. How do I free up space?
faq.preview: Remove content you no longer need.

answer.title: Free Up Storage
answer.body: Remove downloaded content you no longer use from the downloads screen. You can also review storage in your device settings. You can download removed content again later.

faq.question: How do I share a Bible verse?
faq.preview: Share Scripture with friends and family.

answer.title: Share a Verse
answer.body: Select the verse you want to share and tap Share. Then choose any sharing method available on your device.

faq.question: How do I create and share a verse image?
faq.preview: Turn a verse into a shareable picture.

answer.title: Create a Verse Image
steps: Select the verse you want.
Choose the image option from the verse actions.
Pick a design, then save or share the image.
If saving fails, allow {{APP_NAME}} to access your photos in device settings.

faq.question: Where do I find the daily verse and how do I get reminders?
faq.preview: See today's verse and manage its reminder.

answer.title: Daily Verse
answer.body: Open the daily verse section to see today's verse. To get a reminder, turn on its notification in the notification settings and allow notifications for {{APP_NAME}} in your device settings.

faq.question: How do reading plans work?
faq.preview: Follow a plan day by day.

answer.title: Reading Plans
steps: Open Reading Plans and choose a plan.
Start the plan and open each day's reading.
Mark a day complete to track your progress.
To stop a plan, open it and choose the option to leave or reset it.

faq.question: How do I add the widget to my home screen?
faq.preview: Show a verse on your home screen.

answer.title: Add a Widget
answer.body: Widgets are added from your device home screen, not from inside the app.

steps: Touch and hold an empty area of your home screen until the icons move.
Tap the plus button at the top.
Search for {{APP_NAME}}, choose a widget size and tap Add Widget.
Touch and hold an empty area of your home screen.
Tap Widgets.
Find {{APP_NAME}}, then drag the widget you want onto your home screen.

faq.question: How do I use or save a verse wallpaper?
faq.preview: Save a verse design to your phone.

answer.title: Verse Wallpapers
answer.body: Open Wallpapers, choose a design, and save or share it. If saving does not work, allow {{APP_NAME}} to access your photos in device settings.

faq.question: How do streaks work, and why did mine reset?
faq.preview: Understand how your streak is counted.

answer.title: Reading Streaks
answer.body: A streak counts consecutive days on which you complete the activity shown on the streak screen. If your streak reset, check that the activity was completed that day, and that your device date and time are set to update automatically.

append_if_feature.text: You can complete your daily streak without internet.

faq.question: Can I complete my daily streak without internet?
faq.preview: Your streak works offline.

answer.title: Daily Streak Offline
answer.body: Yes. The daily verse, prayer and devotion for your connection level, and your daily streak, work without an internet connection. They are free. Keep your device date and time set to update automatically so your streak is counted correctly.

append_if_feature.text: They do not use credits.
They do not need Premium.

faq.question: Is the daily verse, prayer and devotion free?
faq.preview: What the daily content costs.

answer.title: Daily Content Is Free
answer.body: Yes. The daily verse, prayer and devotion for your connection level are free, and they work offline.

append_if_feature.text: They do not use credits.
No Premium is needed.
They are not AI answers, so there is no AI charge.

faq.question: How do I create a prayer?
faq.preview: Create a prayer for what is on your heart.

answer.title: Create a Prayer
steps: Open the Prayer section.
Tell us what you would like to pray about.
Choose the prayer length you want.
Confirm to create your prayer.

append_if_feature.text: Longer prayers use more credits, and the cost for each length is shown before you confirm.

faq.question: What is the Prayer Wall?
faq.preview: Share requests and pray with others.

answer.title: The Prayer Wall
answer.body: The Prayer Wall is a shared space where {{APP_NAME}} users can post prayer requests and read requests from others. Posts can be seen by other users, so please do not include personal details.

faq.question: How do I post a prayer request?
faq.preview: Add a request to the Prayer Wall.

answer.title: Post a Prayer Request
steps: Open the Prayer Wall.
Choose to add a new prayer request.
Write your request. Do not include private details such as your full name, phone number, address or other personal information.
Post it.

faq.question: How do I remove my prayer request?
faq.preview: Take down a request you posted.

answer.title: Remove a Prayer Request
steps: Open the Prayer Wall and find your request.
Open its options and choose Delete.
If you cannot remove it, contact App Support and tell us which request it is.

faq.question: How do I report a Prayer Wall post?
faq.preview: Report a post that concerns you.

answer.title: Report a Prayer Wall Post
steps: Open the post you are concerned about.
Open its options and choose Report.
If you cannot report it that way, use Report a Problem below and tell us which post it is.
answer.body: If you believe someone is in immediate danger, please contact your local emergency services.

faq.question: How do I block someone on the Prayer Wall?
faq.preview: Stop seeing a person's posts.

answer.title: Block a Person
steps: Open a post or profile from the person you want to block.
Open its options and choose Block.
Confirm that you want to block them.
answer.body: Blocking works both ways. You will not see their posts or profile, and they will not see yours.

faq.question: How do I get an AI explanation of a verse?
faq.preview: Understand a verse with AI.

answer.title: Verse Explanation
steps: Open the verse you want to understand.
Select the verse and choose the explanation option.
Make sure you have an internet connection, because explanations are created online.
Wait for the explanation to appear.

append_if_feature.text: Before you confirm, choose how long you want the explanation to be. The credit cost for that length is shown first.
Your free daily use of this feature is shown on the screen.

faq.question: How do I get an AI summary of a chapter?
faq.preview: Get the main points of a chapter.

answer.title: Chapter Summary
steps: Open the chapter you want summarized.
Choose the summary option.
Make sure you have an internet connection, because summaries are created online.
Wait for the summary to appear.

append_if_feature.text: Before you confirm, choose how long you want the summary to be. The credit cost for that length is shown first.
Your free daily use of this feature is shown on the screen.

faq.question: How do I ask the Bible Assistant a question?
faq.preview: Chat with the Bible Assistant.

answer.title: Bible Assistant Chat
steps: Open the Bible Assistant.
Type your question.
Send it and wait for the answer.
answer.body: App Support is separate from the Bible Assistant. Support can help with using the app, but Bible questions are answered in the Bible Assistant.

append_if_feature.text: Choose your answer length before you send. Each message uses credits based on that length, and the cost is shown first.
Your free daily chats are shown on the screen.

faq.question: How many credits does an AI answer use?
faq.preview: How answer length affects the cost.

answer.title: Credits for AI Answers
answer.body: Each AI answer uses credits, and the amount depends on the answer length you choose. The cost for each length is shown before you confirm. This applies to every AI feature in the app that lets you choose a length.

faq.question: What do short, medium and long answers mean?
faq.preview: Choose the answer length that suits you.

answer.title: Answer Length
answer.body: A short answer is brief, a medium answer gives more detail, and a long answer is the most detailed. Longer answers use more credits. Choose the length before you confirm, and the cost is shown first.

faq.question: Is any AI use free?
faq.preview: Why AI uses credits from the start.

answer.title: Is AI Free?
answer.body: AI answers in {{APP_NAME}} use credits from the very first one, based on the answer length you choose. There is no free daily AI allowance in this app.

append_if_feature.text: You can collect free credits in the Wallet and use them for AI answers.
You can also earn credits by watching an ad when one is offered.
Your daily verse, prayer and devotion, and your daily streak, do not use credits and are free.

faq.question: What is the free daily AI allowance?
faq.preview: How free AI use works.

answer.title: Free Daily AI Allowance
answer.body: AI features in {{APP_NAME}} include a free allowance each day. When the free allowance for a feature has been used, the app shows your options.

faq.question: I've used my free AI allowance. What can I do?
faq.preview: Your options once the free allowance is used.

answer.title: Free Allowance Used
answer.body: You can wait for the free allowance to renew the next day.

append_if_feature.text: You can also use credits. Open the Wallet to see your balance and how to get more.
Or choose an unlimited plan, if one is available. The Premium screen shows it.

faq.question: Why does AI chat ask for credits?
faq.preview: How AI chat uses credits.

answer.title: Credits for AI Chat
answer.body: After the free daily allowance for AI chat has been used, each message uses credits. The cost is shown before you send.

append_if_feature.text: If your plan includes unlimited AI chat, messages do not use credits.

faq.question: How do I manage notifications?
faq.preview: Turn reminders on or off.

answer.title: Manage Notifications
answer.body: Open the notification settings in {{APP_NAME}} to choose which reminders you receive. You can also allow or block all notifications for the app in your device settings.

faq.question: How do I change the app language?
faq.preview: Change the language of menus and buttons.

answer.title: Change App Language
answer.body: Open the language settings and choose the language you want for menus and buttons. This changes the app interface only. The Bible version you read is chosen separately.

faq.question: How do I back up or restore my bookmarks and notes?
faq.preview: Keep your saved content safe.

answer.title: Back Up and Restore
steps: Open the backup settings.
Turn on backup or choose Back Up Now.
On a new device or after reinstalling, open the backup settings again and choose Restore.

faq.question: How do I move my bookmarks and notes to a new phone?
faq.preview: What to expect when changing devices.

answer.title: Moving to a New Device
answer.body: Your saved content is stored on your device. It may be carried over if you restore your new device from your device backup, depending on your device backup settings.

append_if_feature.text: Premium is linked to your {{STORE_NAME}} account, so on the new device use Restore Purchases.

faq.question: I can't sign in to my account.
faq.preview: Steps to regain access.

answer.title: Sign-in Problems
steps: Check your internet connection.
Make sure you are using the same sign-in method you used to create the account.
Use the password reset option if you have one.
If you still cannot sign in, contact App Support. Never share your password with anyone.

faq.question: How do I delete my account?
faq.preview: Remove your account and its data.

answer.title: Delete Your Account
steps: Open the account settings.
Choose Delete Account and follow the prompts.

append_if_feature.text: Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription. Cancel any active subscription separately in {{STORE_NAME}}.

faq.question: How do I delete my data?
faq.preview: Where your data is stored and how to remove it.

answer.title: Delete Your Data
answer.body: {{APP_NAME}} does not need an account, and your saved content is stored on your device. Deleting the app removes it from the device.

append_if_feature.text: Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription, so cancel it separately in {{STORE_NAME}}.

faq.question: How is my data used? Where is the privacy policy?
faq.preview: Read our privacy policy and terms.

answer.title: Privacy and Terms
answer.body: How {{APP_NAME}} handles your data is described in the privacy policy. The terms of use explain the rules for using the app.

faq.question: How do I update the app?
faq.preview: Get the latest version of {{APP_NAME}}.

answer.title: Update the App
answer.body: Open {{STORE_NAME}}, find {{APP_NAME}}, and tap Update if an update is available. You can also turn on automatic updates in your device settings. Updating does not remove your saved content.

append_if_feature.text: Premium stays linked to your {{STORE_NAME}} account. If it looks locked after updating, use Restore Purchases.

faq.question: How do I contact App Support?
faq.preview: Reach our support assistant or team.

answer.title: Contact App Support
answer.body: Ask your question in App Support. Common questions are answered instantly, our support assistant helps with the rest, and a member of our team can step in if needed. You can also ask for a person at any time.

faq.question: Why am I seeing ads?
faq.preview: About ads in {{APP_NAME}}.

answer.title: About Ads
answer.body: Some versions of {{APP_NAME}} show ads. Ad content is supplied by third-party ad networks. If you see an ad that is inappropriate, send us a problem report with a screenshot and we will look into it.

faq.question: How do I remove ads?
faq.preview: Find out whether ads can be removed.

answer.title: Remove Ads
answer.body: If {{APP_NAME}} offers a way to remove ads, it is shown inside the app.

append_if_feature.text: Open the Premium screen to see whether removing ads is part of an option available to you. If you already bought an option that removes ads and still see ads, use Restore Purchases, then contact App Support.

faq.question: What do I get with Premium?
faq.preview: See what's included before you upgrade.

answer.title: About Premium
answer.body: Premium unlocks extra features in {{APP_NAME}}. The Premium screen always shows what is currently included, the plans on offer, and the terms, before you confirm anything.

faq.question: Which features are free and which need Premium?
faq.preview: How to tell what is locked.

answer.title: Free and Premium Features
answer.body: Features that need Premium are marked in the app. Tap a locked feature, or open the Premium screen, to see what is included. What is free and what is paid can change over time.

faq.question: How much does Premium cost?
faq.preview: Check the price available to you.

answer.title: Premium Pricing
answer.body: Plans and prices are shown on the Premium screen before you purchase. Prices can differ by country, currency, plan and any current offer, and the final amount is always shown by {{STORE_NAME}} before you confirm.

faq.question: Is Premium a subscription or a one-time purchase?
faq.preview: Know what you are buying.

answer.title: Subscription or One-Time
answer.body: The Premium screen shows each option and whether it renews or is a one-time purchase, along with its length, before you confirm. Read these details carefully before you buy.

faq.question: How does the free trial work?
faq.preview: Understand your trial before you start.

answer.title: About the Free Trial
answer.body: When a free trial is offered, its length, the price after the trial, and the renewal terms are shown before you confirm. To avoid being charged, cancel before the trial ends in your {{STORE_NAME}} subscription settings.

faq.question: What does unlimited AI mean on my plan?
faq.preview: Understand the AI access included in a plan.

answer.title: Unlimited AI
answer.body: If your plan includes unlimited use of specific AI features, the Premium screen lists exactly which ones.

append_if_feature.text: Auto-renewing plans can be managed or cancelled in your {{STORE_NAME}} subscription settings.

faq.question: How do I upgrade to Premium?
faq.preview: Steps to purchase.

answer.title: Upgrade to Premium
steps: Open the Premium screen.
Choose the plan you want and review its terms.
Confirm the purchase with {{STORE_NAME}}.
If Premium does not unlock straight away, use Restore Purchases.

faq.question: Can I use Premium on more than one device?
faq.preview: How Premium follows your account.

answer.title: Premium on Other Devices
answer.body: Premium is linked to the {{STORE_NAME}} account that made the purchase, not to a single device. On another device signed in to the same account, install {{APP_NAME}} and use Restore Purchases.

faq.question: Can my family share my Premium?
faq.preview: Sharing Premium with family members.

answer.title: Sharing Premium
answer.body: Premium belongs to the {{STORE_NAME}} account that bought it. Whether family sharing applies depends on the purchase and on your store's family settings. The Premium screen and your store's family settings show what is available to you.

faq.question: How do I restore my purchase?
faq.preview: Get back a purchase you already made.

answer.title: Restore Your Purchase
steps: Make sure your device is signed in to the {{STORE_NAME}} account used for the original purchase.
Connect to the internet.
Tap Restore Purchases below, or on the purchase screen.
If your purchase is still missing, contact App Support.

faq.question: I paid, but Premium is still locked.
faq.preview: Unlock Premium after a successful payment.

answer.title: Premium Still Locked
steps: Confirm you are signed in to the same {{STORE_NAME}} account that paid.
Tap Restore Purchases.
Close and reopen {{APP_NAME}}.
If Premium is still locked, contact App Support and tell us what happened. Never send your password or full payment-card details.

faq.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.preview: Stop your subscription from renewing.

answer.title: Cancel Your Subscription
answer.body: Subscriptions are managed in the {{STORE_NAME}} account that made the purchase, not inside {{APP_NAME}}. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. After you cancel, Premium normally stays active until the end of the period you already paid for.
steps: Open your device's subscription settings.
Select {{APP_NAME}}.
Choose Cancel and confirm.
Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad.
Tap your name at the top, then tap Subscriptions.
Select {{APP_NAME}}.
Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm.
Open the Google Play Store app.
Tap your profile picture, then Payments & subscriptions, then Subscriptions.
Select {{APP_NAME}}.
Tap Cancel subscription and follow the prompts.

faq.question: I cancelled, but I still have Premium. Why?
faq.preview: What happens after you cancel.

answer.title: Cancelled but Still Active
answer.body: When you cancel, the subscription stops renewing but normally stays active until the end of the period you already paid for. Your {{STORE_NAME}} subscription details show the exact end date and whether it is cancelled.

faq.question: Where can I see or manage my subscription?
faq.preview: View your plan and renewal date.

answer.title: Manage Your Subscription
answer.body: Your plan, renewal date and controls are in your {{STORE_NAME}} subscription settings, under the account that made the purchase.

faq.question: How do I change my plan?
faq.preview: Switch to a different plan.

answer.title: Change Your Plan
answer.body: Open your {{STORE_NAME}} subscription settings, select {{APP_NAME}}, and look for the other available plans. Options and timing depend on what is offered to your account and on {{STORE_NAME}} rules.

faq.question: Why did my subscription renew?
faq.preview: How automatic renewal works.

answer.title: Why It Renewed
answer.body: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period unless they are cancelled before the renewal date. Some stores require cancelling at least a day before. Your {{STORE_NAME}} subscription details show the renewal date and whether auto-renew is on. If you did not mean to renew, you can request a refund from {{STORE_NAME}}.

faq.question: How do I request a refund?
faq.preview: Where to ask for your money back.

answer.title: Requesting a Refund
answer.body: Purchases are processed by {{STORE_NAME}}, and refunds are decided by {{STORE_NAME}} under its own policies. We cannot issue refunds ourselves, but we can point you to the right place.

steps: Open Get Purchase Help below and sign in with the Apple ID used for the purchase.
Choose the option to request a refund.
Select {{APP_NAME}} from your purchases, choose a reason and submit.
Apple reviews the request and decides the outcome.
Open Google Play and find the order in your order history.
Look for the refund or report-a-problem option for that order.
If no option appears, use Google Play Help to ask about the order.

faq.question: Why was I charged after my free trial?
faq.preview: Understand trial conversion.

answer.title: Charged After a Trial
answer.body: A free trial converts to a paid subscription unless it is cancelled before the trial ends, as explained when the trial started. Your {{STORE_NAME}} subscription details show the renewal date and status. If you want a refund, see how to request one.

faq.question: I was charged unexpectedly, or I don't recognize a charge.
faq.preview: Find out what a charge is for.

answer.title: Unrecognized Charge
steps: Check your {{STORE_NAME}} purchase history for the charge and the app it belongs to.
Check whether the purchase was made on another account or device that you or a family member use.
If the charge is from {{APP_NAME}} and you did not authorize it, contact App Support. If you think your account was used without permission, also contact {{STORE_NAME}} support.

append_if_feature.text: Also check your subscription settings for any active subscription you forgot about.

faq.question: I was charged more than once.
faq.preview: Check whether the charges are separate or duplicates.

answer.title: Charged More Than Once
steps: Check your {{STORE_NAME}} purchase history to see each charge and what it was for.
Check whether you have more than one purchase, for example on different accounts or devices.
A temporary hold from your bank can look like a second charge and usually disappears by itself.

If two charges for the same purchase appear in your {{STORE_NAME}} history, request a refund for the duplicate from {{STORE_NAME}}, then contact App Support and tell us what happened. Never send your password or full payment-card details.

faq.question: Why did my payment fail?
faq.preview: Get help when a purchase won't complete.

answer.title: Payment Failed
answer.body: Payments are handled by {{STORE_NAME}}. Check your payment method and account details there, then try again. If it keeps failing, contact {{STORE_NAME}} payment support.

faq.question: My purchase is pending or waiting for approval.
faq.preview: Why a purchase may not complete right away.

answer.title: Purchase Pending
answer.body: Some purchases wait for approval, for example when a family organizer must approve them, or for payment confirmation from your bank or carrier. Once it is approved, open {{APP_NAME}} and check again.

append_if_feature.text: If Premium is still locked, use Restore Purchases.

faq.question: The Premium plans won't load or aren't available.
faq.preview: Fix an empty or failing Premium screen.

answer.title: Plans Not Loading
steps: Check your internet connection.
Make sure you are signed in to {{STORE_NAME}} on your device.
Close and reopen {{APP_NAME}}, then try again.
If the plans still don't appear, report the problem and tell us your country.

faq.question: How do credits work?
faq.preview: Understand your wallet balance.

answer.title: How Credits Work
answer.body: Some features in {{APP_NAME}} use credits. Your Wallet screen shows your balance, what uses credits, and any ways to get more, before anything is spent.

append_if_feature.text: AI answers use credits based on the answer length you choose, and the cost is shown before you confirm.

faq.question: I bought credits but they didn't arrive.
faq.preview: Recover credits from a purchase.

answer.title: Credits Not Added
steps: Close and reopen {{APP_NAME}} and check your Wallet balance again.
Check your {{STORE_NAME}} purchase history to confirm the purchase was completed and charged.
If you were charged and the credits are still missing, contact App Support and tell us the date and time of the purchase. Never send your password or full payment-card details.

faq.question: Do credits expire, and can they be refunded?
faq.preview: Where to find the credit rules.

answer.title: Credit Rules
answer.body: The rules for credits are shown on the Wallet screen and before you buy. Refunds for purchases are decided by {{STORE_NAME}} under its own policies.

faq.question: How do I get free credits?
faq.preview: Collect credits for free.

answer.title: Free Credits
answer.body: Open the Wallet. When a free credit is ready, collect it there.

append_if_feature.text: You can also earn credits by watching an ad when one is offered.

faq.question: How do I earn credits by watching an ad?
faq.preview: Turn a short ad into credits.

answer.title: Earn Credits with an Ad
answer.body: In the Wallet, choose the option to watch an ad for credits when one is offered. Watch the ad until it finishes so your credits are added.

faq.question: How do I buy credits?
faq.preview: Add credits to your Wallet.

answer.title: Buy Credits
steps: Open the Wallet.
Choose a credit pack. The price is shown before you confirm.
Confirm the purchase with {{STORE_NAME}}.
Your credits are added once the purchase completes.

faq.question: I don't have enough credits.
faq.preview: Ways to get more credits.

answer.title: Not Enough Credits
answer.body: Open the Wallet to see your options for getting more credits.

append_if_feature.text: Free credits can be collected from the Wallet when one is ready.
You can also earn credits by watching an ad when one is offered.
Credit packs can be bought in the Wallet, and the price is shown before you confirm.

faq.question: My credits are missing after reinstalling or changing phones.
faq.preview: Get help with missing credits.

answer.title: Credits After Reinstalling
answer.body: Credits may not carry over automatically after a reinstall or on a new device. Contact App Support, tell us what happened and roughly when you last used your credits, and we will check what can be done.

append_if_feature.text: If your app has backup or sign-in, restore it first.

faq.question: Where do I manage a subscription I bought on iPhone or Android?
faq.preview: Subscriptions live in the store you bought from.

answer.title: Manage It Where You Bought It
answer.body: A subscription is managed in the store that billed it. A subscription bought through the Apple App Store is managed in your Apple account's subscription settings. A subscription bought through Google Play is managed in Google Play. {{APP_NAME}} cannot change or cancel it for you.

faq.question: I bought on one platform. Can I use Premium on another?
faq.preview: Moving between iPhone and Android.

answer.title: Premium on a Different Platform
answer.body: Purchases are linked to the store account that made them, and a purchase on one store does not automatically carry over to another. If you have switched platforms, contact App Support and tell us what you bought and where.

keywords: bought on iphone use on android
bought on android use on iphone

faq.question: The app is crashing or won't open.
faq.preview: Quick fixes for crashes and launch problems.

answer.title: App Crashes or Won't Open
steps: Close {{APP_NAME}} completely and open it again.
Update the app to the latest version in {{STORE_NAME}}.
Make sure your device has enough free storage and is not in a very low battery state.
Restart your device and try again.
If it still crashes, send us a problem report and tell us what you were doing when it happened.

faq.question: Why isn't Bible audio playing?
faq.preview: Quick steps to restore audio.

answer.title: Audio Isn't Playing
steps: Check your device volume, and that silent mode or Bluetooth is not blocking the sound.
Check your internet connection, because audio may stream online.
Pause and restart the audio, then try another chapter.
Close and reopen the app.
If it still doesn't work, report the problem and tell us the book and chapter.

faq.question: Why does Bible audio keep stopping?
faq.preview: Troubleshoot interrupted audio.

answer.title: Audio Keeps Stopping
steps: Check that your internet connection is stable.
Check that low-power or battery-saving mode is not restricting {{APP_NAME}} in the background.
Restart the audio and try again.
If it continues, send us a problem report with the chapter where it happens.

append_if_feature.text: You can also download the audio first so it plays without a connection.

faq.question: Verses or other content isn't loading.
faq.preview: Fix content that won't appear.

answer.title: Content Not Loading
steps: Check your internet connection.
Close and reopen the app.
Update the app to the latest version.
If it still doesn't load, report the problem and tell us which book, chapter or content is affected.

faq.question: My download is stuck or keeps failing.
faq.preview: Get a stuck download moving again.

answer.title: Download Stuck or Failing
steps: Check your internet connection and, if you can, switch to a stronger Wi-Fi network.
Make sure your device has enough free storage.
Keep {{APP_NAME}} open until the download finishes, and turn off low-power mode.
Cancel the download and start it again, or close and reopen the app.
If it still fails, report the problem and tell us which item you were downloading.

faq.question: My bookmarks, notes or highlights are missing, for example after reinstalling or updating.
faq.preview: What to try when saved content disappears.

answer.title: Saved Content Missing
steps: Check that you are viewing the right section and Bible version.
Update the app and reopen it.
If you deleted or reinstalled the app, restore your device from a device backup if you have one. Content that was stored only on the device may not be recoverable if no backup exists.
If content is still missing, report the problem and tell us what happened just before it disappeared.

append_if_feature.text: If you use backup or sign-in, make sure you are using the same account as before and restore your in-app backup.

faq.question: My content isn't syncing between devices.
faq.preview: Fix backup and sync problems.

answer.title: Sync Not Working
steps: Check that you are signed in to the same account on both devices.
Check your internet connection on both devices.
Open the backup settings and run a manual backup or sync.
Update the app on both devices.
If it still doesn't sync, report the problem.

faq.question: Why is the app slow, lagging or freezing?
faq.preview: Simple steps to improve performance.

answer.title: App Running Slowly
steps: Close and reopen {{APP_NAME}}.
Make sure you have enough free storage on your device.
Update the app and your device software.
Restart your device.
If the slowdown continues, report the problem and tell us your device model.

faq.question: I'm not getting notifications.
faq.preview: Check permissions and settings.

answer.title: Notifications Not Arriving
steps: Open the notification settings in {{APP_NAME}} and make sure the reminder you want is turned on.
In your device settings, allow notifications for {{APP_NAME}}.
Check that Focus, Do Not Disturb or battery-saving modes are not hiding them.
If a reminder still doesn't arrive, report the problem.

faq.question: Text is cut off, overlapping or looks wrong.
faq.preview: Fix layout and display problems.

answer.title: Display or Layout Problem
steps: Check the text size in {{APP_NAME}} appearance settings and try a smaller size.
Check your device display size and larger-text settings, which can affect how the app looks.
Update the app to the latest version.
If it still looks wrong, send a report with a screenshot and your device model.

faq.question: I found a mistake in the Bible text.
faq.preview: Report a wrong, missing or garbled verse.

answer.title: Mistake in the Text
answer.body: Thank you for telling us. Please send a report with the Bible version, book, chapter and verse, and what looks wrong. Please do not paste long passages. Our team will check it against the source.

faq.question: The app is showing the wrong Bible version or text.
faq.preview: Check which version you are reading.

answer.title: Wrong Version or Text
answer.body: Check which Bible version is selected, and remember that the app language and the Bible version are separate settings. Close and reopen the app. If the text still looks wrong, send a report with a screenshot and tell us the version, book, chapter and verse.

append_if_feature.text: Also check that a second or side-by-side version is not turned on by mistake.

faq.question: How do I report inappropriate or harmful content?
faq.preview: Tell us about content that should not be there.

answer.title: Report Content
answer.body: Send a report and tell us where you saw it. A screenshot helps us find it quickly. Please do not include personal details about other people. Our team will review it.

faq.question: The challenge link won't open.
faq.preview: Fix a link that doesn't work.

answer.title: Challenge Link Not Opening
steps: Make sure the whole link was copied and shared, with nothing cut off.
Check your internet connection.
Try opening the link in a different browser or app.
Ask the sender to share the challenge again.
If it still won't open, report the problem and include the link.

faq.question: My challenge results aren't updating.
faq.preview: Fix missing or wrong play counts.

answer.title: Results Not Updating
steps: Check your internet connection, because results are recorded online.
Close and reopen the app, then open your challenge results again.
Give it a short while, since new plays can take a moment to appear.
If the numbers still look wrong, report the problem and tell us which challenge.

faq.question: I can't create a challenge.
faq.preview: Fix a challenge that won't be created.

answer.title: Can't Create a Challenge
steps: Check your internet connection.
Update the app and try again.
If it still can't be created, report the problem and tell us what you chose before it failed.

append_if_feature.text: Also check whether your free daily creation has been used. The create screen shows your options.

faq.question: I can't collect my free credit.
faq.preview: Fix the free credit timer.

answer.title: Free Credit Not Ready
steps: Free credits can be collected only when the Wallet shows one is ready. Wait until it is ready.
Check your internet connection.
Close and reopen the app.
If you still can't collect it, report the problem.

faq.question: The ad won't load, or I watched an ad and got no credits.
faq.preview: Fix ad rewards.

answer.title: Ad or Ad Reward Problem
steps: Check your internet connection.
Turn off any VPN or ad blocker, which can stop ads from loading.
Ads are not always available, so try again after a short while.
Watch the ad until it finishes, then check your Wallet balance.
If you finished an ad and no credits were added, report the problem and tell us the time it happened.

faq.question: Credits were taken but the quiz helper didn't work.
faq.preview: Get help when credits are spent in a quiz.

answer.title: Credits Spent, Helper Didn't Work
steps: Close and reopen the app and check your Wallet balance again.
Check that the question loaded fully.
If credits were taken but the helper did not appear, report the problem and tell us which quiz and when it happened.

faq.question: My free AI allowance didn't renew.
faq.preview: Fix an allowance that is still used up.

answer.title: Free Allowance Not Renewing
steps: Close and reopen the app.
Check your internet connection.
Check again after a short while.
If the allowance still hasn't renewed, report the problem and tell us which AI feature.

faq.question: The AI isn't answering, or keeps failing.
faq.preview: Fix an AI answer that won't load.

answer.title: AI Not Responding
steps: Check your internet connection, because AI answers are created online.
Close and reopen the app, then try again.
Try again after a short while.
If it keeps failing, report the problem and tell us which AI feature it was.

faq.question: Credits were used but I didn't get an AI answer.
faq.preview: Get help when credits are used and nothing arrives.

answer.title: Credits Used, No Answer
steps: Close and reopen the app and check your Wallet balance again.
Check your internet connection and look at the screen where you asked, in case the answer is still loading.
If credits were used and no answer appeared, report the problem and tell us the feature, the time, and the answer length you chose.

faq.question: An AI answer seems wrong or concerning.
faq.preview: What to do about a mistaken or harmful AI answer.

answer.title: Wrong or Concerning AI Answer
answer.body: AI answers can be incomplete or mistaken, so please check them against Scripture and speak with a trusted pastor or teacher about important matters. If an answer was offensive or harmful, you can report it.

faq.question: My prayer request isn't showing on the Prayer Wall.
faq.preview: Fix a post that doesn't appear.

answer.title: Prayer Request Not Showing
steps: Check your internet connection.
Close and reopen the app, then open the Prayer Wall again.
Give it a short while, since new posts can take a moment to appear.
Posts that break the app's community rules can be removed.
If it still does not appear, report the problem and tell us roughly when you posted it.

faq.question: A feature is missing or changed after an update.
faq.preview: Find a feature that moved or disappeared.

answer.title: Feature Missing After an Update
steps: Close and reopen {{APP_NAME}} so the update can finish.
Look in the menu and in Search, because features sometimes move.
Check that your Bible version, language and settings are still what you expect.
If it is still missing, tell us which feature and what you expected to see.

append_if_feature.text: If a Premium feature looks locked, use Restore Purchases first.

support_chat.title: App Support
support_chat.subtitle: Ask anything about your {{APP_NAME}}.
support_chat.first_input_placeholder: Ask your question about the app...
support_chat.welcome_message: Hi! I can help with using {{APP_NAME}}, settings, purchases and problems with the app. How can I help?

suggested_prompts.text: How many credits does an AI answer use?
Can I complete my daily streak offline?
How does the Prayer Wall work?
How do I create a Verse Challenge?
How do I get free credits?
How do I change Bible versions?
How do I cancel my subscription?
I found a mistake in the Bible text

on_ambiguous_match.message: Did you mean one of these?

local_match.note: Typed messages longer than max_words_for_auto_answer always go to the support backend so that the sensitive-topic check runs. FAQs the user taps from a list never need the check.

backend_response_contract.note: The backend returns an intent. For every intent except app_help, the app shows the fixed text from this file, never AI-generated text.

bug_report.message: It sounds like something isn't working correctly. I can help you report this problem.

feature_request.message: That sounds like a feature suggestion. You can send it directly to our team.

unclear.message: I want to make sure I help with the right thing. Could you tell me a little more about what you need help with in {{APP_NAME}}?

client_hints.note: Lightweight client-side hints only. The backend classifier is the authority.

offline.message: You're offline. Common answers are still available in the help topics. You can write your question now and send it when you're back online.

errors.backend_unavailable: We couldn't reach support right now. You can browse help topics, or send a problem report and we'll follow up.

support_chat.welcome_message_no_purchases: Hi! I can help with using {{APP_NAME}}, settings and problems with the app. How can I help?
support_chat.welcome_message_rule: Use welcome_message_no_purchases when neither premium nor credits is enabled.

messages.offer: I'm not able to fully solve this one. Would you like me to pass it to our support team?
messages.forced_topic_notice: This needs a person to look at it, so I'm passing it to our support team.
messages.confirmation: Thanks. Your conversation has been passed to our support team. You can follow it in Support History.
